# Helix

1. From this directory, copy the themes:

   ```sh
   mkdir -p ~/.config/helix/themes
   cp lacuna-*.toml ~/.config/helix/themes/
   ```

2. Add this to `~/.config/helix/config.toml`:

   ```toml
   theme = "lacuna-ink"
   ```

3. Use `lacuna-paper` for the light theme, or switch in Helix with `:theme lacuna-paper`.
